title: Build replacement text from groups
description: You can preserve captured text while reordering or computing selected pieces.

steps.description: The first two substitutions move the first name before the last name. Named captures express the same reorder as numbered captures.
These replacements keep a captured prefix or hour. Literal replacement text changes the remaining matched portion.

steps.question: Will the two replacement strings preserve the same hours?
steps.answer: No. The explicit group reference preserves the hour; the octal escape replaces each whole time with @.

steps.description: The two time results differ as predicted. The ordinary string in the next example supplies control characters instead of group references.
A replacement function receives each match. The displayed calls convert hours and uppercase declaration names while keeping the other captured pieces.
